creativeotter.title: CreativeOtter
creativeotter.description: Use CreativeOtter for image creation, saved images, brand kits, characters, account questions and creative project planning. Route a specific media request to its focused skill.
creativeotter.short_description: Images, saved work and creative project planning

creativeotter-generate-image.title: Create or edit an image
creativeotter-generate-image.description: Create or edit one image through CreativeOtter, using a suitable native image tool or the available provider model. Use for social posts, ads, illustrations and image corrections.
creativeotter-generate-image.short_description: Create and edit images with private saved delivery
creativeotter-generate-image.prompt: Create an Instagram post for my bakery.

creativeotter-product-photoshoot.title: Product image sets
creativeotter-product-photoshoot.description: Create a coordinated set of product images or carousel slides through the supported CreativeOtter image workflow, reusing product and brand references.
creativeotter-product-photoshoot.short_description: Coordinated product photos and carousel image sets
creativeotter-product-photoshoot.prompt: Make three product photos using these references.

creativeotter-create-avatar.title: Create a reusable avatar
creativeotter-create-avatar.description: Create an avatar or character sheet using CreativeOtter image generation, then save its approved image as a reusable character. Voice and talking-video generation are not available.
creativeotter-create-avatar.short_description: Make an avatar and save its approved identity
creativeotter-create-avatar.prompt: Create a friendly otter mascot for my bakery.

creativeotter-create-character.title: Save a reusable character
creativeotter-create-character.description: Save, inspect or update an existing CreativeOtter character and its ready reference image. Use create-avatar to generate a new identity sheet.
creativeotter-create-character.short_description: Save and reuse character appearance and references
creativeotter-create-character.prompt: Save this mascot for my future posts.

creativeotter-plan-video.title: Plan a video
creativeotter-plan-video.description: Write a video brief, script and ordered shot list, and save a CreativeOtter film storyboard when requested. This workflow does not generate footage or speech.
creativeotter-plan-video.short_description: Plan scripts and save ordered film storyboards
creativeotter-plan-video.prompt: Plan a six-shot video for my bakery launch.

creativeotter-budget-projects.title: Organize projects and costs
creativeotter-budget-projects.description: Group CreativeOtter saved images by client or project and read original attributed credit costs. Budget targets are planning targets, not automatic spending caps.
creativeotter-budget-projects.short_description: Organize saved work and inspect project image costs
creativeotter-budget-projects.prompt: Group these saved images under my bakery campaign.

creativeotter-setup.title: Get started with CreativeOtter
creativeotter-setup.description: Help users connect CreativeOtter and discover its currently enabled image, library and planning features. A setup request does not authorize paid samples.
creativeotter-setup.short_description: Connect your account and tour available features
creativeotter-setup.prompt: Help me get started with CreativeOtter.

creativeotter-submit-feedback.title: Prepare product feedback
creativeotter-submit-feedback.description: Draft a CreativeOtter product or media-quality report when explicitly requested. Direct feedback submission is not implemented.
creativeotter-submit-feedback.short_description: Draft a clear product or media quality report
creativeotter-submit-feedback.prompt: Help me report a problem with this image.

creativeotter-generate-voiceover.title: Plan narration or dialogue
creativeotter-generate-voiceover.description: Prepare narration, dialogue and reusable voice direction for CreativeOtter. Speech generation and synthetic voice design are not yet implemented.
creativeotter-generate-voiceover.short_description: Write narration and save reusable voice direction
creativeotter-generate-voiceover.prompt: Write a warm welcome voiceover for my bakery.

creativeotter-clone-voice.title: Prepare a consented voice project
creativeotter-clone-voice.description: Explain what is needed for an authorized voice-cloning project. CreativeOtter voice cloning and audio upload are not implemented; do not collect recordings for this workflow.
creativeotter-clone-voice.short_description: Prepare an authorized voice project without cloning
creativeotter-clone-voice.prompt: Can I use my own voice for a future ad?

creativeotter-generate-music.title: Plan music and lyrics
creativeotter-generate-music.description: Write music briefs or lyrics and save them in CreativeOtter. Music generation, remixing and audio downloads are not implemented.
creativeotter-generate-music.short_description: Develop lyrics and save a music production brief
creativeotter-generate-music.prompt: Write a cheerful jingle idea for my bakery.

creativeotter-generate-sound-effects.title: Plan sound effects
creativeotter-generate-sound-effects.description: Write sound-effect and ambience briefs for CreativeOtter. Sound-effect generation and audio rendering are not currently implemented.
creativeotter-generate-sound-effects.short_description: Describe sound effects and plan their timing
creativeotter-generate-sound-effects.prompt: Plan gentle cafe ambience for this advertisement.

creativeotter-generate-video.title: Plan a video clip
creativeotter-generate-video.description: Develop a single video clip concept, prompt or animation plan. CreativeOtter video generation, extensions, lip-sync and source transformations are not implemented.
creativeotter-generate-video.short_description: Plan a video clip while generation is unavailable
creativeotter-generate-video.prompt: Plan an animation of this mascot waving hello.

creativeotter-build-film.title: Plan a complete film
creativeotter-build-film.description: Plan a multi-shot CreativeOtter film with script, continuity and storyboard. Footage, speech, audio mixing and final assembly are not implemented.
creativeotter-build-film.short_description: Develop a complete film script and storyboard
creativeotter-build-film.prompt: Plan a short launch film for my new cafe.

creativeotter-create-ugc-ad.title: Plan a creator-style ad
creativeotter-create-ugc-ad.description: Write a creator-style product ad script and shot plan. CreativeOtter presenter video, speech, lip-sync and assembled UGC production are not implemented.
creativeotter-create-ugc-ad.short_description: Write a creator-style product ad and shot plan
creativeotter-create-ugc-ad.prompt: Write a 20-second creator-style ad for my coffee.

creativeotter-ad-variations.title: Plan advertisement variations
creativeotter-ad-variations.description: Develop alternative ad hooks, scripts and shot plans. CreativeOtter video ad generation, voice replacement and caption rendering are not implemented.
creativeotter-ad-variations.short_description: Develop ad hook variations and production plans
creativeotter-ad-variations.prompt: Give me five different hooks for this coffee ad.

creativeotter-create-reels.title: Plan short clips from existing video
creativeotter-create-reels.description: Suggest Reel or short-video cuts from supplied footage or a transcript. CreativeOtter transcription, video cutting, reframing and subtitle rendering are not implemented.
creativeotter-create-reels.short_description: Plan short social clips from existing footage
creativeotter-create-reels.prompt: Which three moments would make good Reels?

creativeotter-edit-media.title: Plan edits to existing video or audio
creativeotter-edit-media.description: Explain or draft cuts, captions, framing, audio and assembly edits for existing media. CreativeOtter video/audio processing is not implemented; image edits use generate-image.
creativeotter-edit-media.short_description: Prepare video and audio edits without rendering
creativeotter-edit-media.prompt: Help me shorten this video and add captions.

creativeotter-swap-characters.title: Plan an authorized video recast
creativeotter-swap-characters.description: Prepare an authorized character-replacement brief for an existing video. CreativeOtter face swaps, character recasting and motion transfer are not implemented.
creativeotter-swap-characters.short_description: Prepare a video recast brief without rendering
creativeotter-swap-characters.prompt: Can I put my mascot into this video?

creativeotter-render-html.title: Create motion graphics and animations
creativeotter-render-html.description: Create and revise motion-graphics videos with animated typography, shapes, transitions and logo reveals. Use for animated graphic designs, not still images or filmed footage.
creativeotter-render-html.short_description: Create animated graphics, text and logo reveals
creativeotter-render-html.prompt: Animate my headline and logo for a short launch announcement.
